name: Operadora de Sites Mexicanos, S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: Operadora de Sites Mexicanos, S.A.B. de C.V. is a Mexican company specializing in telecommunications infrastructure. Its operations include the development, setup, upkeep, management, rental, and promotion of diverse towers and other supporting structures for the telecom industry across Mexico. The firm additionally provides end-to-end construction services for base transceiver station (BTS) sites. These services encompass everything from identifying and acquiring suitable land to installing and operating necessary equipment, alongside preparing physical spaces and other non-electronic components vital for establishing service networks. They handle various tower designs, such as guyed, self-supporting, monopole towers, and masts. Founded in 2015, the company is headquartered in Mexico City and formerly operated as a subsidiary of Telesites, S.A.B. de C.V.
